consentText.message: To improve Auto Refresh Plus, this extension collects the web addresses (URLs) of pages you visit and the page you came from (referrer URL), linked to a random anonymous ID. We use this to measure how the extension is used and to find pages where auto-refresh isn't working. This data is sent to our servers, is never sold, and is never shared with third parties. You can decline and still use the extension. You can learn more in our

extensionDescription.message: Auto Refresh Plus automatically refresh and reload any page or tab after a specified number of seconds
